originalJourney.name: FIN-IND-005 Finance performance preserves confirmed sensitivity and preserves the 15000/15001 journey through replay and real restart
originalJourney.budgetInterpretation: The fixture guard is 180000 ms; the journey test explicitly allows 300000 ms, while the CLI default is 120000 ms. No budget was raised. The fixture guard ended this execution before the per-test ceiling.

failure.phaseInterpretation: The guard string names the last fixture progress marker prepare:transition-confirmed:complete. The active measured operation was the second confirmed.coverage.verify, nested under confirmed.evaluate, with confirmed.authority.resolve and confirmed.units.resolve active. It is not evidence that fixture preparation itself was still running.

historicalScenarioReadsAlreadyObserved.limit: These earlier C08 scenario reads do not substitute for the later history.read, replay, restart and access assertions that were not reached.
